title: Instructions for Planar Area Analysis using CPCe 4.1 Software
author: Rebecca Maher
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pmvdk66
materials: Open up CPCe 4.1 software and click ‘Measurement’ → ‘Area/Measurement Analysis’ and open up the downloaded image file.

steps.title: Download and open image
steps.instruction: Download and save the best‑quality raw image file from the long‑term photo‑monitoring plots, then open it in CPCe 4.1.

steps.title: Set analysis display options
steps.instruction: Click the ‘Area/Length Analysis’ tab (upper left), check ‘Display area values’ and ‘Use species colors’, and choose a fill color and trace line color.

steps.title: Calibrate image scale
steps.instruction: Select the ‘Scaling calibration’ tab → ‘Perform image scaling/calibration’; zoom to a factor of 6.00 (Ctrl + left‑click to zoom in, Ctrl + right‑click to zoom out). For the two bottom corners spaced 261 cm apart, click the first corner, fine‑tune with arrow keys, then click the second corner and fine‑tune again. Enter the known distance (261 cm); the software will generate the scaling resolution.

substeps.instruction: After scaling, each picture displayed 18.800 pixels/cm.

steps.title: Enter header information
steps.instruction: In the header dialog, enter ‘Location’ and ‘Quad Number’, then press ‘Close’.

steps.title: Set tracing zoom
steps.instruction: Set zoom factor to 3.50 by zooming into the image before tracing.

steps.title: Trace coral colonies
steps.instruction: Left‑click to begin tracing; move the pointer along the edges of each clearly identifiable Orbicella franksi colony (including partially visible ones, around obstacles, and dead tissue). Use scroll bars or right‑click‑drag to navigate; left‑click to pause and left‑click again to resume; press ESC to erase the previous trace if a mistake is made. Only trace colonies with clearly defined edges.

steps.title: Complete region and record area
steps.instruction: When a contiguous coral region is fully traced, right‑click to finish; the area is automatically calculated and displayed with a number in parentheses. To delete an area, type its parenthesized number into the ‘Erase Area’ box. Traced regions are filled with the selected ‘Fill Color’.

steps.title: Save area file
steps.instruction: Click the ‘File’ tab (left corner) → ‘Save area (.ara) file’ and save the image as a .ara file.

steps.title: Repeat tracing for all colonies
steps.instruction: Continue tracing all Orbicella franksi colonies in the image, saving frequently via ‘File’ → ‘Save’ → ‘Save area (ara) file’ to prevent data loss.

steps.title: Export data to Excel
steps.instruction: Go to ‘File’ → ‘Save’ → ‘Save .ara file(s) to excel’; choose the desired .ara file, click “New Excel Workbook”, leave ‘Transect name’ blank, click ‘Process Files’, select ‘.xlsx (Open XML)’ in the pop‑up, click OK, specify the Excel file name and location, and click OK to create the Excel file. Close any running Excel files if prompted.

steps.title: Final save of .ara file
steps.instruction: After all targeted areas are calculated, click ‘File’ → ‘Save area (.ara) file’ one more time.

steps.title: Prepare next image
steps.instruction: To analyze a new image, click ‘File’ → ‘Exit’, then repeat steps 1‑11 for the next image file.

description: Go to View Data and record the area per photo and any notes in spreadsheet.
